title: Only These Nodes
description:
Kiosk workloads belong on the lobby node pool — not on the batch farm next door.

Use affinity and/or tolerations so the Pod lands on the correct node set. Landing on the wrong node fails the grade even if the Pod is Running.

**Meant for:** Node affinity / taints & tolerations.

problemStatement.brief: Schedule Guestbook onto the correct node set with affinity and/or tolerations — wrong node fails.
